uncertainty.caveat: Exploratory percentile block bootstrap with only four blocks; not significance proof. No call/update pooling. Position balance does not eliminate carryover or thermal drift.

native_plain_rate.formula: mean(log seconds of ab) - mean(log seconds of ef)

native_profile_rate_descriptive.interpretation: positive means retained is faster; profiled descriptive contrast only
native_profile_rate_descriptive.formula: mean(log seconds of cd) - mean(log seconds of gh)

original_observer_time_overhead.formula: mean(log seconds of cd) - mean(log seconds of ab)

retained_observer_time_overhead.formula: mean(log seconds of gh) - mean(log seconds of ef)

aa_b_over_a_rate.interpretation: positive means b is faster than a
aa_b_over_a_rate.formula: mean(log seconds of a) - mean(log seconds of b)

aa_d_over_c_rate.interpretation: positive means d is faster than c
aa_d_over_c_rate.formula: mean(log seconds of c) - mean(log seconds of d)

aa_f_over_e_rate.interpretation: positive means f is faster than e
aa_f_over_e_rate.formula: mean(log seconds of e) - mean(log seconds of f)

aa_h_over_g_rate.interpretation: positive means h is faster than g
aa_h_over_g_rate.formula: mean(log seconds of g) - mean(log seconds of h)

interpretation: Absolute phase seconds and own-run wall shares include observer cost; do not mechanically subtract total overhead from individual phases.
The disjoint partition replaces inclusive collect with collect excluding env calls plus env_step and env_reset. Inclusive collect must not be added again.

Modeled total speedups hold all other time unchanged and are NOT a hard core ceiling. The env-call region includes Python adaptation, conversion, native waiting and observer overhead; background workers can affect other phases.
Process CPU/whole wall is contextual aggregate process utilization, not a disjoint phase or per-core efficiency measure. Negative observer and A/A estimates are retained.

raw_plan.purpose: Attribute reference PPO wall time and quantify observer cost; no core changes
raw_plan.counterfactual_scope: EnvPool Python call time includes conversion and native waits; background work can affect other phases. Any Amdahl model holds the rest constant and is not a hard core bound.
raw_plan.sampling: One predeclared fixed trial, all runs retained, no adaptive stopping
raw_plan.pairing: Two replicas per condition per block; symmetric slots and condition/label position balance, not elimination of carryover or thermal noise
